name: Nanaru Redspirit
original_name: ナナルゥ・レッドスピリット
source:
"..... What would you have me do?"

She is very serious about following her orders faithfully, so much so that her will is synchronized with that of her Eternity Sword and she has almost lost her sense of self. She doesn't let her emotions show on her face, so those who can distinguish her real feelings are few and far between.
translation:
“……你希望我做什么？”

她认真到近乎偏执地服从命令，以至于意志与自己的永恒之剑同步，几乎失去了自我。她从不在脸上表露情绪，因此能分辨她真实感受的人寥寥无几。
